data.body:
[P2] Resume earlier deadlines before advancing later parallel waits

`QueueScheduler.scheduleFunction()` executes every checkpoint-update callback immediately, so these ticks advance through all waits in a polled batch before the next invocation. If one parallel branch performs two sequential one-hour waits while another performs one three-hour wait, the clock reaches hour 3 before the first branch resumes. Its second wait then uses the new client timestamp and ends at hour 4, although the workflow should finish at hour 3. Process pending deadlines in time order, allowing resumed work to run before completing and advancing to later deadlines. Add a regression test combining sequential waits with a longer parallel sibling.
